methods.label: Determine the linear coefficients
methods.explanation: \(k=(7-3)/(3-1)=2\). Then \(3=2\times1+b\) gives \(b=1\), so the intersection with the \(y\)-axis is \((0,1)\).
methods.levelReason: The coefficient calculation follows from the two point conditions using Grade 8 linear functions and elementary equations; high-school analytic geometry is unnecessary.
